description: November 25 birthday meaning: Sagittarius decan 1, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 25 birthday falls in Sagittarius, in the first decan, with Jupiter as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Sagittarius is mutable and fire.

sections.heading: November 25 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Sagittarius loves big questions, and the 25th of November turns that love inwards. The Sun at about three degrees sits in Jupiter's decan, linked with philosophy and growth, while 7 is numerology's seeker of meaning. The combination suggests an independent thinker, often fascinated by belief systems, distant cultures or the history of ideas, and comfortable travelling alone.

On November 25 the Sun usually sits at about 3° Sagittarius, in the first decan, where Jupiter rules the decan as well as the sign. Jupiter rules Sagittarius and presides over its first decan as well, from about November 23 to December 1. This is traditionally the most expansive, optimistic stretch of the sign. Natives are often described as adventurous, generous and philosophical, eager to travel, learn and share whatever they have discovered. Humour and candour come easily, and so can a tendency to say the true thing a little too bluntly. Doubled Jupiter can make commitments multiply faster than time allows. These Archers tend to thrive when their search for meaning has room to roam but also somewhere to come home to.

sections.heading: November 25 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 25th, your compound 2 + 5 reduces to 7. The 2's intuition and the 5's curiosity come together in the 7's reflective, analytical temperament. People born on the 25th are frequently described as perceptive, observant and drawn to understanding how things and people really work. They may test ideas through experience before trusting them. In its secondary role, the 25 is traditionally linked with a strong inner voice and a need for quiet time to process what they have gathered. Their insight often becomes valuable to others once they decide to share it.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one November 25 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22.

sections.heading: Born on November 25: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 25 is the 329th day of the year (330th in a leap year). By December 22, 27 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Capricorn.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 25, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on November 25 include John XXIII (1881), Augusto Pinochet (1915) and Andrew Carnegie (1835).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 25?
faq.answer: November 25 is Sagittarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Sagittarius, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 25?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 25 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 2 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 22 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 25th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 25?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 25 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 25?
faq.answer: November 25 is also the birthday of John XXIII (1881), Augusto Pinochet (1915) and Andrew Carnegie (1835). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
